The Neighbors effect is larger among people who voted in the 2004 primary. I measured each effect as the Neighbors turnout rate minus the Control turnout rate in 2006.

| Voted in 2004 primary | Neighbors effect on 2006 turnout |
|---|---|
| Yes | 0.0965 |
| No | 0.0693 |

The difference is 0.0965 − 0.0693 ≈ 0.027.

ANSWER: 0.027
